## 🚀 NexAlloy - Official Transition

This release marks the final rebranding of the project and its formal migration to the **NexAlloy Organization**, introducing a new visual identity and a refined foundation.

### ⚠️ Data & Configuration (Action Required)
Since we have switched to new patches, your old YouTube ReVanced settings **will not** carry over automatically. **You must export them before installing this update.**

**Migration Steps:**
1.  **Backup:** Open your current **YouTube** app, go to `Settings -> ReVanced -> Misc -> Import/Export`, and copy your settings.
2.  **Update:** Install NexAlloy over your existing app.
3.  **Restore:** Open **YouTube** again, navigate to the new `Settings -> Morphe -> Misc -> Import/Export`, paste the settings you just copy.

[Changelog](https://github.com/chsbuffer/ReVancedXposed/releases/tag/2.0.102)

NexAlloy


**ChsBuffer's LSPosed module, powered by Morphe, ReVanced, and beyond.** > ⚠ Caution > **Migration Notice:** This project has evolved from **ReVancedXposed** to **NexAlloy**. > > **Upgrading:** We’ve kept the original Package ID for your convenience. You can install this as an update, but **you must manually export your settings from the old version and import them into the new one** to keep your configuration. > ⚠ This is **NOT an official Morphe or ReVanced project**, do not ask their developers for help. ## Full description [Link to Main Repository](https://github.com/NexAlloy/NexAlloy) ## Supports [![Discord Server](https://img.shields.io/badge/Join-Discord-5865F2.svg?logo=discord)](https://discord.gg/QWUrAA2mKq) [Create an issue](https://github.com/NexAlloy/NexAlloy/issues/new/choose) ## ⭐ Credits [DexKit](https://luckypray.org/DexKit/en/): a high-performance dex runtime parsing library. [Morphe](https://morphe.software): Transform Your Android Apps [ReVanced](https://revanced.app): Continuing the legacy of Vanced at [revanced.app](https://revanced.app) ## Donate [AFDian](https://afdian.com/a/ChsBuffer)
